svg.title: There is no exterior sign in this convention. A coefficient has order a if all its real Taylor coefficients of total degree below a at zero vanish. Each contraction increases this order by one. The given two-potential tensor is u ∈E1 ⊗E1, of order s+2, satisfying both gauge contractions C0 −u = 0 and Hu = 0. Apply the dependent-block division to obtain
